# Midland Global Technology Fund

## Investment Guidelines

Version 2. Effective from 1 January 2025. This version supersedes Version 1 with effect from that date; the single issuer limit in Section 1.1 has been amended and all other sections are carried forward unchanged. These Guidelines form part of the Fund's Investment Policy Statement and bind the Portfolio Manager in respect of all dealing on behalf of the Fund.

### 1. Concentration limits

1.1 No single issuer shall exceed 10% of the Fund's net asset value. Where a proposed transaction would take issuer exposure to 90% or more of this limit, the Portfolio Manager shall notify the Chief Investment Officer before dealing.

1.2 Aggregate exposure to the Technology sector shall not exceed 35% of the Fund's net asset value. Where a proposed transaction would take sector exposure to 90% or more of this limit, the Portfolio Manager shall notify the Chief Investment Officer before dealing.

1.3 For reference only, the benchmark index caps any single constituent at 12% of index weight; this is not a restriction on the Fund.

### 2. Liquidity

2.1 The Fund shall maintain cash and cash equivalents of at least 2% of net asset value. A shortfall against this floor is a soft limit: it shall be reported to the Portfolio Manager for remediation and does not by itself prevent dealing.

### 3. Restricted issuers

3.1 The Fund shall not hold any security issued by an entity on the Compliance Restricted List, and no exception to this restriction may be granted.

3.2 Schedule A sets out the Compliance Restricted List as maintained by the Compliance Officer.

### 4. Exceptions

4.1 Except where these Guidelines state that no exception may be granted, a breach of a limit in Section 1 may be waived for up to 30 days (Section 1.1) or 60 days (Section 1.2) with the written approval of the Portfolio Manager, the Chief Investment Officer and the Compliance Officer, applying four-eyes control. A shortfall under Section 2.1 may be waived by the Portfolio Manager alone.

### Schedule A: Compliance Restricted List

- Volkov Industrial Holdings
- Meridian Tobacco Group
- Kestrel Defence Systems
